title: We Need More Leaders
coreMove: Take local responsibility for the human cost near you before hierarchy gives you permission.
sourcePressure: Closes by distributing leadership: humane institutions need more people taking local responsibility for protection and human cost instead of waiting for titles above them.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Calling for more managers, more charismatic leaders, or heroic lone saviors.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: kennel tech seeing a harmful norm
exampleSpecs.stakes: local leadership starts before a title arrives
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she changes the handoff note for frightened dogs and asks peers to use it that day
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a kennel card clipped to a gate

exampleSpecs.stakes: leadership is making human cost visible locally
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he posts a fee log and organizes three neighbors before calling management
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a coin slot beside a handwritten fee log

exampleSpecs.stakes: protective action can happen from the middle of the system
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she stops the van until the cooler straps are fixed, though dispatch has not asked
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cooler strap beside a route tablet

exampleSpecs.audience: student assistant seeing exclusion of late commuters
exampleSpecs.stakes: passivity keeps the room less human
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the assistant reviews who misses supplies because the closet closes early and proposes a new check-out box
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a supply closet key beside a checkout card

exampleSpecs.stakes: distributed leadership protects people in the moment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the usher predicts waiting for the manager will be too late and moves the patron to a staffed aisle
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a ticket stub beside an aisle flashlight

exampleSpecs.stakes: small-sphere leadership confronts cost before policy catches up
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she marks apartment numbers on a knock list and knocks before the afternoon heat peak
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a thermometer beside an apartment knock list
